rows.sfo_browse_sql:
SELECT k.*, c.cat_name FROM tkt_kb k LEFT JOIN tkt_category c ON c.tkt_category_id = k.kb_tkt_category_id
WHERE k.kb_public = 1 OR '#ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE#' <> 'tkt_customer'

SELECT * FROM tkt_comment
WHERE (com_internal = 0 OR '#ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE#' <> 'tkt_customer')
ORDER BY com_created

SELECT t.*, r.sus_name AS requester_name, a.sus_name AS agent_name, c.cat_name
FROM tkt_ticket t
LEFT JOIN zzzzsys_user r ON r.zzzzsys_user_id = t.tic_requester_id
LEFT JOIN zzzzsys_user a ON a.zzzzsys_user_id = t.tic_agent_id
LEFT JOIN tkt_category c ON c.tkt_category_id = t.tic_tkt_category_id
WHERE '#ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE#' NOT IN ('tkt_customer', 'tkt_agent', 'tkt_specialist')
   OR ('#ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE#' = 'tkt_customer' AND t.tic_requester_id = '#USER_ID#')
   OR ('#ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE#' = 'tkt_agent' AND (t.tic_level = 1 OR t.tic_agent_id = '#USER_ID#'))
   OR ('#ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE#' = 'tkt_specialist' AND (t.tic_level = 2 OR t.tic_agent_id = '#USER_ID#'))
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

rows.emt_body:
Hello [requester],

your ticket #tic_number# was resolved:

[resolution]

Please rate our answer in the portal (★ to ★★★★★). If the problem is not solved, simply reply in the ticket – it opens again.

Hello [requester],

thank you for contacting us. Your ticket #tic_number# – #tic_subject# – was created with priority #tic_priority#.

We will answer by [due]. You can follow it in the support portal under My tickets.

Kind regards
Your support team

rows.description: Tickets sample: start page of customers – only their own tickets

rows.title: Support desk
rows.description: Tickets sample: start page of agents, specialists and the team lead

rows.title: Open
rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_requester_id = '#USER_ID#' AND t.tic_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed')

rows.title: Waiting for me
rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*), NULL, 'we need an answer from you' FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_requester_id = '#USER_ID#' AND t.tic_status = 'pending'

rows.title: Resolved
rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_requester_id = '#USER_ID#' AND t.tic_status IN ('resolved', 'closed')

rows.title: My latest tickets
rows.query: SELECT t.tkt_ticket_id AS nu_record_id, t.tic_number AS Ticket, t.tic_subject AS Subject, t.tic_status AS Status, t.updated_at AS Updated FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_requester_id = '#USER_ID#' ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC

rows.title: Open tickets
rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*), NULL, 'new, open, waiting, escalated' FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed')

rows.title: Overdue
rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*), NULL, 'open and past the due date' FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND t.tic_due < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

rows.title: Assigned to me
rows.query: SELECT COUNT(*), NULL, 'open tickets of #USER_FIRST_NAME#' FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') AND t.tic_agent_id = '#USER_ID#'

rows.title: Average rating
rows.query: SELECT AVG(t.tic_rating), NULL, 'stars given by customers' FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_rating > 0

rows.title: New tickets per day
rows.query: SELECT CAST(t.created_at AS DATE) AS Day, COUNT(*) AS Tickets FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.created_at BETWEEN '#DATE_FROM#' AND '#DATE_TO# 23:59:59' GROUP BY CAST(t.created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY 1

rows.title: Open by priority
rows.query: SELECT t.tic_priority, COUNT(*) FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') GROUP BY t.tic_priority

rows.title: Open by agent
rows.query: SELECT COALESCE(u.sus_name, '(not assigned)') AS Agent, COUNT(*) AS Tickets FROM tkt_ticket t LEFT JOIN zzzzsys_user u ON u.zzzzsys_user_id = t.tic_agent_id WHERE t.tic_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') GROUP BY u.sus_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

rows.title: Tickets by category
rows.query: SELECT c.cat_name, COUNT(*) FROM tkt_ticket t JOIN tkt_category c ON c.tkt_category_id = t.tic_tkt_category_id WHERE t.created_at BETWEEN '#DATE_FROM#' AND '#DATE_TO# 23:59:59' GROUP BY c.cat_name ORDER BY 2 DESC

rows.title: Due next
rows.query: SELECT t.tkt_ticket_id AS nu_record_id, t.tic_number AS Ticket, t.tic_subject AS Subject, t.tic_priority AS Priority, t.tic_due AS Due FROM tkt_ticket t WHERE t.tic_status NOT IN ('resolved', 'closed') ORDER BY t.tic_due

rows.kb_body:
Open the sign-in page and choose Forgot password?. Enter your e-mail address; the link in the e-mail is valid for 30 minutes.

  1. Choose a password with at least 12 characters.
  2. Sign in again.

Check the time of your computer – a clock that is more than 5 minutes off stops the VPN.

Restart the VPN client and try the backup server vpn2.example.com.

rows.kb_title: Where do I find my invoices?
rows.kb_body: All invoices are in the customer portal under Documents → Invoices, as PDF.

rows.kb_title: Laptop docking station: screens stay black
rows.kb_body: Update the firmware of the dock (tool DockUpdate), then connect the screens one after the other.
Internal: the add-ins are rolled out by group policy – check the group of the user in the directory.

rows.sob_html_code:
What to look at

  • Tickets: filters Category, Priority, Status, Assigned to and Requester (design mode, column Filter); badges for priority, status and an overdue Due date – nuBrowseStyleBadge with rules in the list's JavaScript (the overdue rule tests the row).
  • Knowledge base: Visibility as Public / Internal badges (design mode, Show as badge, no code), filter Category.
  • Categories: Active as a badge, filter Team.
  • Dashboards: Support desk above – a row of Due next opens the ticket in a new tab; customers see My tickets instead.
